{{Quote|Observing the world around them, they saw two moons in the one sky&mdash;light Ashla and dark Bogan&mdash;and they understood the dual aspects to the Force, light and dark.|[[Ketu]], on [[Tythan]]s|<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Bogan''' was one of the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Observing both Bogan and [[Ashla (moon)/Legends|Ashla]], the other natural satellite, the [[Tythan|first settlers]] of Tython recognized the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] aspects of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Later, both moons were colonized by non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Tythans who built stone [[City/Legends|cities]] there and subsequently settled [[Settled Worlds|the rest]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,793 BBY]], Bogan had been abandoned by the settlers and was used as a place of [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] by the [[Je'daii Order]] for its members who had veered too much to the dark side of the Force. Those Je'daii would contemplate the light of the moon of Ashla, while the Je'daii sent to Ashla for straying too far to the light side meditated on Bogan in return.

==Description==
Along with [[Ashla (moon)/Legends|Ashla]], Bogan comprised the pair of [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] that was located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="DotJ0" /> at galactic coordinates L-10.<ref name="EAOC" /> From [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Bogan appeared to be mostly [[Color/Legends|rusty-brown]] in color.<ref name="DotJ2" /> The moon had an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that was breathable to [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="DotJ2" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Tythans who were not Je'daii left Tython, going first to the moons, Ashla and Bogan, and from there outward&mdash;to populate the other worlds in the system.|Ketu|<ref name="DotJ1" />}}
When the [[Tythan|first settlers]] of Tython observed Ashla and Bogan, they developed the notions of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]&mdash;which they also called Ashla and Bogan, respectively&mdash;and understood the necessity for a balance between those two Force aspects.<ref name="DotJ1" /> These beliefs gave rise to a legend of the [[Je'daii Order]] which stated that the two moons were birthed by Tython from its fiery core in order to remind of the perpetual struggle between dark and light to all those who sought balance.<ref name="DotJ6" /> In the second [[Time/Legends|millennium]] following the [[Tho Yor Arrival|settlement]] of Tython,<ref name="DotJ1" /> the non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Tythans colonized the moons, building stone [[City/Legends|cities]] there, and later settled the [[Settled Worlds|rest of the worlds]] in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="DotJ6" />
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="CBR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/nycc-exclusive-ostrander-and-duursema-unveil-star-wars-dawn-of-the-jedi|text=NYCC EXCLUSIVE: Ostrander and Duursema Unveil "Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi"|date=2011-10-13|author=Manning, Shaun|archivedate=20200817183352}}</ref> Bogan had been abandoned by the settlers and was used as a place where the Je'daii would send those members of the Order who had strayed too far to the dark side of the Force. Those [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Je'daii would [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] on the moon of Ashla in order to re-achieve balance between the two aspects of the Force, while, conversely, the Je'daii who had veered too much to the light side were sent to Ashla and contemplated the moon of Bogan.<ref name="DotJ0" />

==Locations==
The first settlers of Bogan built cities on the moon, using stone as a building material. The ruins of those cities were used millennia later by the Je'daii who were banished to the moon.<ref name="DotJ6" /> The exiled Je'daii [[Daegen Lok]] visited the ruins on at least two occasions<ref name="DotJ2" /><ref name="DotJ3">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 3]]</ref> in 25,793 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="CBR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The moon Bogan was first depicted in [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]], a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]] and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. Bogan made its first [[in-universe]] appearance in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first issue]] of the series, published on [[February 15]] of the same year. The moon later appeared in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|second]], the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 3|third]], the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|fifth]] and the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|sixth]] issue of the comics. Bogan was mentioned in the 2012 reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', as well.

In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]&mdash;a single moon of Tython appeared in a cutscene depicting the player-controlled [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Padawan's]] approach to the planet; however, the moon remains to be identified as either Ashla or Bogan. This cutscene was later revised (as part of an update to all class introductions and planetary approaches) to show both moons, but both are depicted as light grey in color.
